pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with moderately sharp edge gradients. Shapes range from elongated quadrilaterals on the upper neck to more complex, multi-sided polygons on the flank. Pixel gradients at edges show a transition from dark brown to light cream within a narrow spatial range.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank, with localized widening at vertex intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the upper neck mane, presenting as a fine, textured silhouette against the background pixels.
